verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic filing is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since states can offer bulk-filing or API access, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive, OHID-credentialed web portals and no API, CLI, or automation surface. Probes found ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning HTTP 403 even on robots.txt, which points away from unattended agent access rather than toward it.
